note: Real-capture sample corpus per OT/ICS protocol, for the oracle tests in tests/real/test_real_ot.py.
Each row names a public capture by repo + commit + path, its sha256, its licence, the parser engine
that reads it (tests/real/_ot_oracle.py) and the protocol that engine must recognise in it.
rev and sha256 are PINS the operator fills, not values this repo invents: fetching is an operator
step gated by rules.public_fetch_allow (see tests/real/fetch_ot.py), never run in build work, so a
row ships with rev/sha256 empty and the fetcher refuses it until both are pinned. licence is
'unverified' until the operator confirms the upstream per-file licence before any redistribution.
No capture file is ever committed to this repo; the corpus lives under $CTF_REALDATA/ot/<proto>/.
A protocol with no located public capture is listed under 'missing', never faked.

automayt.licence: unverified: aggregation of third-party public captures; confirm each file's upstream licence

wireshark.licence: unverified: Wireshark sample captures; confirm the individual capture's licence
